schema.text: When you use public transport, how demanding is it compared with other ways you could travel?
schema.help: Think of both physical and mental effort. Other ways could be walking, cycling or driving.

options.text: I have no other way to travel

en.#When you use public transport, how dema: When you use public transport, how demanding is it compared with other ways you could travel?
en.#I have no other way to travel: I have no other way to travel
en.#Think of both physical and mental effor: Think of both physical and mental effort. Other ways could be walking, cycling or driving.

it.#When you use public transport, how dema: Quando usi i mezzi pubblici, quanto è impegnativo rispetto ad altri modi di spostarsi?
it.#I have no other way to travel: Non ho altri modi per spostarmi
it.#Think of both physical and mental effor: Pensa sia allo sforzo fisico sia a quello mentale. Gli altri modi possono essere camminare, andare in bici o guidare.

fr.#When you use public transport, how dema: Lorsque vous utilisez les transports en commun, dans quelle mesure est-ce exigeant par rapport aux autres moyens de se déplacer ?
fr.#Much easier than the others: Beaucoup plus facile que les autres
fr.#I have no other way to travel: Je n'ai pas d'autre moyen de me déplacer
fr.#Think of both physical and mental effor: Pensez à l'effort physique comme mental. Les autres façons peuvent être la marche, le vélo ou la conduite.

de.#When you use public transport, how dema: Wie anstrengend ist das Fahren mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln im Vergleich zu anderen Fortbewegungsarten, die Sie nutzen könnten?
de.#I have no other way to travel: Ich habe keine andere Möglichkeit, unterwegs zu sein
de.#Think of both physical and mental effor: Denken Sie an körperliche und geistige Anstrengung. Andere Möglichkeiten wären Gehen, Radfahren oder Autofahren.

tr.#When you use public transport, how dema: Toplu taşıma kullanırken gidebileceğiniz diğer yollara kıyasla bu ne kadar zahmetli?
tr.#Think of both physical and mental effor: Hem fiziksel hem de zihinsel eforu düşünün. Diğer yollar yürümek, bisiklet sürmek veya otomobil kullanmak olabilir.

fa.#When you use public transport, how dema: هنگام استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی، در مقایسه با روش‌های دیگر رفت‌وآمد، چقدر سخت و پرزحمت است؟
fa.#Think of both physical and mental effor: هم تلاش جسمی و هم ذهنی را در نظر بگیرید. روش‌های دیگر می‌تواند پیاده‌روی، دوچرخه‌سواری یا رانندگی باشد.

hu.#When you use public transport, how dema: Tömegközlekedés közben mennyire megterhelő ez a többi lehetőséghez képest, amellyel utazhatna?
hu.#Think of both physical and mental effor: Gondoljon a testi és a szellemi megterhelésre is. Más módok lehetnek a gyaloglás, a kerékpározás vagy az autózás.

ar.#When you use public transport, how dema: عند استخدام وسائل النقل العام، ما مدى صعوبة ذلك مقارنةً بوسائل التنقل الأخرى المتاحة لك؟
ar.#Think of both physical and mental effor: المقصود الجهد البدني والذهني معًا. ومن الوسائل الأخرى المشي أو ركوب الدراجة أو القيادة.
